name: motion-elastic-drag
title: Elastic Drag
description: Con trỏ kéo nút ra xa theo một đường cong, một sợi dây chun nối với chỗ cũ mảnh dần khi căng; thả ra nút bật về chỗ cũ bằng lò xo, vượt qua một chút.

moworks.author: takayu

options.tether: [base, extra, falloff px]: width = base + extra / (1 + distance / falloff) ([8, 32, 160])
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-elastic-drag, written here): Chip 84x36 r12 at its home (dashed outline). Grabbed at 0.42 s, dragged 1:1 from (104,104) to (232,70) over 0.5-1.25 s power2.inOut with a 10 px upward bow; held; released at 1.45 s it springs home on k180 c11 (about 24 % overshoot). A tether from the home dot to the chip, width 2 + 8 / (1 + distance / 30) px, 55 % opacity. Params: from / to · drag (0.75 s, power2.inOut) · release (1.45 s) · spring (k180 c11) · tether.
